outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rates
cohort: 189 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-COV-2 infection and oxygen saturation < 95% admitted to 12 hospitals in Iran between March 2020 and June 2021.
finding: The inclusion of Remdesivir in the treatment of pregnant women with COVID-19 was associated with a reduced rate of vertical transmission of SARS-COV-2 to neonates and fewer neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
